intro: Convert inches to feet accurately for human height, carpentry trim, ceiling spans, and architectural layouts. Because 1 international foot equals exactly 12 inches (0.3048 meters), dividing any measurement in inches by 12 gives decimal feet, while the remainder gives standard feet-and-inches or inches into linear feet. Use the conversion table below for common building sizes, tenths of a foot, and fractional tape readings.
alsoWrittenAs: in to ft, inches into linear feet, inch to foot, inches to tenths of a foot, in into ft
tableSubtitle: Complete inch to feet conversion table from 1 in to 240 in (computed as ft = in ÷ 12).
tableRoundingNote: Calculated using the exact 1 ft = 12 in definition (1 in = 0.08333333... ft). Repeating decimals are rounded to 5 significant digits in the table; multiples of 12 inches are exact whole feet.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Tenths of a Foot, Linear Feet & US Survey Feet
items: Inches to Tenths of a Foot vs. Feet-and-Inches: Civil and grading plans use decimal feet (tenths of a foot, where 5.5 ft = 5 ft 6 in). Never read 5.5 ft as 5 ft 5 in (66 in vs. 65 in).

Inches to US Survey Feet: Everyday construction uses the international foot (0.3048 m, exactly 12 in). The legacy US Survey Foot (1200/3937 m) differs by 2 parts per million (1 survey ft ≈ 12.000024 international inches), which only matters for geodetic coordinates over thousands of feet.
Inches into Linear Feet: When pricing lumber, trim, or pipe per linear foot, simply divide total inches by 12—board width does not change the linear foot total.

faqs.question: How do you convert inches to feet (and tenths of a foot)?
faqs.answer: Divide the number of inches by 12. For example, 69 inches ÷ 12 = 5.75 feet (5 feet 9 inches). To read inches in tenths of a foot for engineering or site grading, keep the decimal output directly (for example, 6 in = 0.5 ft).

faqs.question: Are inches into linear feet calculated the same way?
faqs.answer: Yes. For lumber, baseboard trim, wire, or piping priced by linear foot, use the exact same formula: linear feet = inches ÷ 12. For example, 98 inches equals 8.16667 linear feet.

faqs.question: How do inches convert to US survey feet?
faqs.answer: For everyday measurements up to several hundred feet, dividing inches by 12 gives the same practical result. Over long geodetic baselines, 1 US survey foot equals 1200/3937 m (12.000024 international inches), a difference of about 0.01 ft per mile.

faqs.question: What is 69 inches in feet?
faqs.answer: 69 inches equals 5.75 feet, or 5 feet 9 inches (69 ÷ 12 = 5.75 ft).
